description:
Scope: test-only, extend test/zaq/ingestion/api_test.exs to exercise lib/zaq/ingestion/api.ex lines 43-44, 76-77, 86-87. Do not change production code. This is separate from zaq-5qu (which targets ingestion.ex and browser). Action reuse gate: not applicable, no executable operation changed; tests exercise existing dispatch actions. No feature/UI E2E or property test needed: this boundary only forwards typed inputs and wraps/preserves responses; broad-input invariants belong with processor/inventory tests.

Detailed TDD scenarios (keep existing use Zaq.DataCase, async: true; no DB fixtures needed):
1. :list_chunk_languages, lines 43-44: add a nested deterministic StubChunkLanguages.list/0 returning a distinctive nonempty language list (e.g. ["english", "french"]). Construct Event.new(%{}, :ingestion, opts: [action: :list_chunk_languages, chunk_languages: StubChunkLanguages]); call Api.handle_event(event, :list_chunk_languages, nil); assert result.response == {:ok, ["english", "french"]} and request/opts unchanged. This tests explicit event.opts override, single list call response wrapped in {:ok, ...}, with no live GenServer or filesystem/global state. Optionally add a separate real-default test calling without override, asserting response == {:ok, Zaq.Ingestion.ChunkLanguages.list()} if default behavior is in scope and deterministic; not required for these uncovered lines.
2. :limit_knowledge_results, lines 76-77: add nested StubDocumentProcessor.limit_chunks/1 which sends(self(), {:limit_chunks, chunks}) then returns a distinctive subset (e.g. Enum.take(chunks, 1)). Construct %Event{request: %{chunks: [first, second]}} via Event.new with opts: [action: :limit_knowledge_results, document_processor: StubDocumentProcessor]; assert {:ok, [first]} and assert_received {:limit_chunks, [first, second]}, preserving opts/request, to prove delegation uses full input but response wraps collaborator output. A list of two small map fixtures is sufficient; no real embedding/database/network. Test guard via separate event %{chunks: :invalid} returning {:error, {:unsupported_action, :limit_knowledge_results}} and no :limit_chunks message; guard path is outside the six target lines but protects invalid input contract.
3. :search_knowledge_base, lines 86-87: nested StubDocumentProcessor.query_extraction/2 sends(self(), {:query_extraction, query, access_opts}) and returns a distinctive {:ok, [result]} for the valid call (or configurable {:error, :search_failed} for a second call). Event.new(%{query: "handbook", access_opts: [person_id: 7, source_filter: ["manual"]]}, :ingestion, opts: [action: :search_knowledge_base, document_processor: StubDocumentProcessor]); assert exact delegated arguments with assert_received, response == collaborator tuple unchanged (no extra {:ok, ...}), and event request/opts unchanged. Add error-result case {:error, :search_failed} if using a stub branch to demonstrate passthrough. Reject malformed query (nonbinary) and malformed access_opts (nonlist) using separate events, assert unsupported_action, no collaborator message.

Reuse Event.new/3, Api.handle_event/3 and existing test module pattern plus StubIngestion precedent in same file; introduce only local small deterministic stubs, no Mox/production seam/new global process. Tests are async-safe, no application env mutation, no sleeps/polling; assert_received is the observable call signal. If genuine external collaborators become necessary, follow handbook Mox per-process expectations, but none are needed here. Validate after implementation with mix test test/zaq/ingestion/api_test.exs and mix q per issue; later final mix precommit only at final approval gate. No full suite/coverage/quality commands during planning. Acceptance: each six lines executed by the three valid-action tests and inputs/shape/return contracts asserted; optional invalid guard tests preserve fallback behavior. No dependencies required for this single test-surface issue.

comments.text: Implemented test-only API dispatch coverage in test/zaq/ingestion/api_test.exs: deterministic chunk-language inventory override; chunk limiting delegation plus malformed chunks guard; knowledge search delegated arguments, success/error passthrough, unchanged event request/opts, and malformed query/access_opts guards. Per coordinator instruction, no tests, formatting, coverage, mix q, or precommit commands run; awaiting isolated validation authorization.
